subject: astronomy
title: Stellar Life Foundations
welcome_lead: Trace a star's journey from a glowing protostar to its final remnant.
meta_desc: GCSE Astronomy: stellar life cycle, HR diagram and main sequence stars.
final_note: You can now describe how stars are born, live and die.

concepts.def: Collapsing cloud of gas heating up before fusion begins.
Stable phase fusing hydrogen into helium in the core.
Expanded cool low/medium mass star after main sequence.
Hot dense remnant of a low-mass star.
Explosive death of a massive star at end of life.
Tiny ultra-dense remnant left after a supernova.

walkthroughs.body_html: Gravity pulls a cloud of gas and dust (a nebula) inwards. As it collapses it heats up to form a protostar. When the core reaches ~10 million K, hydrogen fusion begins and a main sequence star is born.

Low/medium mass stars (like the Sun) swell to red giants, then shed a planetary nebula leaving a white dwarf. Massive stars become red supergiants, then explode as a supernova leaving a neutron star or black hole.
The Hertzsprung-Russell diagram plots luminosity (bottom to top) against temperature (right to left, hot on the left). Most stars sit on the diagonal main sequence band.

options: Hydrogen
Helium
Carbon
Iron

options: White dwarf
Neutron star
Black hole
Brown dwarf

mcqs.q: What defines a star as being on the 'main sequence'?
options: It is the hottest stage.
Lunar eclipses are more dangerous.
It fuses hydrogen into helium in its core.
It is the largest stage of a star's life.

mcqs.q: Why is Jupiter classified as a gas giant?
options: Lunar eclipses are more dangerous.
Its bulk is mostly hydrogen and helium with no defined solid surface.
It is mostly air like Earth's atmosphere.
It is made of fire.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between a solar eclipse and a lunar eclipse?
options: It is made of fire.
In a solar eclipse the Moon blocks the Sun; in a lunar eclipse Earth's shadow covers the Moon.
Lunar eclipses are more dangerous.
Solar eclipses happen by day, lunar at night - that is the only difference.
